_comment: Mission «ВКЛ 6. Волчья тропа, 1507» (mission card in the missions doc, docs/03-missions/08-gdl_06_wolf_trail_1507.md). A stealth mission without a base: Prince Konstanty Ostrogski (player 1), who swore allegiance to Vasily III, slips away from his border service through the forests into Lithuania with three servants on horseback, past the Muscovite watch (player 2: posts with dogs, patrols with torches, a watchtower at the zaseka); a night, a day and a second night; at the end Andrei Gintovt (player 1 too) holds the border ford against the chase of the centurion Nezhdan. The place and the route are not in the sources: the map is the forest of the Smolensk borderland towards Mstislavl, with no names on it. Rules (core/mission/mission_stealth.gd): the watch, the detection meter and the alarm, day and night, tired horses and horses led on foot, the stable, hidden places of power and the trails «Волчья тропа» opens from them, the Keeper's gať (player 3 keeps her: she does not take orders). Read by core/mission/mission_def.gd; cells are map cells, ticks 1/20 s, texts are English keys translated through i18n/*.po.
title: GDL 6. The Wolf Trail, 1507

briefing.place: The forest borderland of Muscovy and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania. The end of August or September 1507.
briefing.story: Seven years after the Vedrosha, Prince Konstanty Ostrogski, the hetman taken captive there, still lives in Muscovy: first in chains, then in honour. In October 1506, after the death of Ivan III, he swore loyal service to Vasily III and received the rank of voivode and lands. In the summer of 1507 he was sent to the border, and there is war between Moscow and Lithuania. Where he slipped away and who rode with him, the sources do not say: this road is the game's.
briefing.goal: Leave the border camp at night without raising the alarm, get past the zaseka, wait out the day in the forest and reach the border ford. There Andrei Gintovt must hold the ford until the prince is across.
lose: Prince Ostrogski is taken or killed
The chase holds the ford before the prince is across

do.text: Prince Ostrogski has fallen. Lithuania will not see its hetman again.

lines: For seven years the hetman lived in Muscovy. First in chains, then in honour. When the old sovereign died, the prince kissed the cross to the new one, Vasily, and received a voivodeship and lands. Some say the metropolitan himself stood surety for him. And in the summer of fifteen hundred and seven he was sent to the border.
Leave the kaftan. I will leave in what I came in.

do.text: Leave the border camp without raising the alarm
Get past the zaseka
Find all 3 places of power
Bring all three servants through
Never raise the alarm

The watch sees in a cone the way it faces: half as far at night, further with a torch, twice as far into a campfire's light. Their dogs smell whoever comes near, and a trot is heard even behind their backs. Keep to the forest: the prince is not seen there at all, his servants only close up.
Lead the horses (V) to go quietly at a walk; then the horses rest too. At a trot they tire, and a tired horse only walks. A full meter of suspicion raises the alarm.
The alarm is up! The watch rides to where it saw you, and the chase will come sooner. Get away into the forest.

lines: A chapel by the road. The prince gets down from his horse and goes inside for a moment. A lamp burns before the icon.
Prince, it will be light soon.
I kissed the cross in captivity, and I break it myself. Nobody released me and nobody will excuse me. Ask it of me alone.
Someone has cut marks on this pine. Like wolf tracks, and all of them one way.
Hunters' marks. Hunters go where there is no watch. We follow them.

do.text: A hidden place of power gives one charge of Power. Stand the prince on it and cast «Wolf Trail»: a trail opens from it through the old forest or the bog for a minute, and on it the dogs find no scent.
Wait out the day and reach the border ford
Sunset in %s
Dawn. By day the watch sees anyone moving in the open from far off: sit in the forest and do not ride over fields and roads.

lines: The prince is gone! Bring the dogs! And tell the voivode: if we do not find him, they will ask it of us as of traitors.

do.text: In the camp they have found him gone. The centurion Nezhdan's chase will set out for the ford; every new alarm brings it nearer.
Night again. The bog is near: the road goes round it to the south, past the watch.

lines: Night. The edge of the bog. At the start of an old log causeway stands an old herb woman with a lantern and a bunch of herbs at her belt. Far off, dogs are barking. Silently she raises the lantern and points at the causeway: thin poles going out into the quagmire.

The old woman does not answer and goes ahead without looking back. The prince gets down and leads his horse by the bridle. The barking behind them falters and goes off to one side, as if the patrol had turned the wrong way. In the middle of the causeway the old woman is gone; only the lantern hangs on a pole.

The hetman himself said afterwards that a local woman who knew the paths led him through the bog. But Andrei swore that he saw wolves that night, going along the bank in a pack, and all of them one way.

do.text: Follow the old woman over the causeway: while you keep near her, the watch suspects nothing.

lines: The other bank. Dawn twilight. Andrei with a patrol by the water.
Someone is riding there. Four of them. And dogs behind them.
Muscovites. Let them sort it out among themselves.
No. I know how he sits in the saddle. Seven years have passed, and I know it. To the ford!

do.text: Hold the ford until the prince is across
Nezhdan's chase has set out from the camp along the road to the ford.
The chase is at the ford! Cross to meet it or strike from the bank.
The chase took the ford before the prince was across.

lines: Ostrogski rides up onto the bank, wet to the waist. Andrei gets down from his horse.
Standard-bearer Gintovt. So you found the ford after all.
This time you found it yourself, prince.
Not myself. What news in Vilnius?
War, prince. Prince Glinski has quarrelled with the lords, and they say no good will come of it.
At the end of September Prince Konstanty was in Vilnius, and at the end of November King Sigismund made him hetman again. Of the oath given in Moscow he never once spoke in our hearing.

do.text: Prince Ostrogski is on the Lithuanian bank. In November the king will make him hetman again.
